name: knowledge-copilot-beta
description: Continuously capture and reconstruct learning from an authorized conversation after one launch.

interface.shortDescription: Keep a floating knowledge notebook beside your conversation.
interface.longDescription: Launch a PiP, fullscreen, or independent knowledge notebook once, bind it to the current conversation, and continue extracting concepts, operations, corrections, and learning debt from later substantive turns without repeated mentions.
defaultPrompt: 开启知识沉淀，并在后续每轮有实质内容的回答后持续更新知识笔记。
复盘当前对话，提取关键操作、原理和待学习问题。
画一张当前技术讨论的知识思维导图。
